notes.title: [Update] BATTLE PIXELS Game Changes/Fixes are Here!
notes.notes:
BATTLE PIXELS  Game Changes/Fixes are Here!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/434500

http://otakumaker.com/images/battle_pixels_616x353.png

Changes/Fixes Game : 

Screen Resolution Fix - Full Screen and Windows mode supported

Updated Controls - 2 Button Controls, control either tank with one click or play in Classic (point and click) Mode.

Level Generation - Level Generation times have been improved.

Game Difficulty - Overall Game Difficulty has been balanced.

Enjoy!

Please restart Steam if the update isn't downloading.
